answer: Make new identities expensive to stamp out in bulk: each agent posts a locked bond, priced like a saffron cargo too dear to clone a thousand times, and can withdraw it only through a delayed-settlement harbor after several epochs of unique work. Independent graders form a verification island that slashes the bond on cloned text, empty seats, or recycled mechanisms, so an attacker's cost grows with every sockpuppet rather than with a cheap script.
